used to 与 would:过去的习惯: 谈"过去常做、现在不再"的事,used to 最稳,would 只能配动作动词。
used to + 动词原形:过去经常,现在不了|否定:didn't use to;疑问:Did you use to...?|would + 动词原形也可表过去反复动作,但不能接状态动词|there used to be 表示"过去曾有"|区别频率:used to 强调今昔对比
I used to play the piano every day.
She didn't use to like coffee.
Did there use to be a bookshop here?
Every summer we would drive to the coast.
column3: 每年夏天我们都会开车去海边。

used to 与 would:过去的习惯: He used to smoke, but he gave it up last year.

# title: My grandfather ___ tell us stories after dinner.
column4: 过去常讲故事,用 used to + 原形。

# title: I ___ be a waiter, but now I teach English.
column4: 今昔对比"过去是",用 used to。

# title: She ___ live so far from the station.
used to 与 would:过去的习惯: don't use to|didn't use to|didn't used to|doesn't used to
column4: 否定形式是 didn't use to。

# title: There ___ a cinema in this street.
used to 与 would:过去的习惯: used to be|use to be|would be|was used to be
column4: 过去曾有,固定说法 there used to be。

# title: When we were kids, we ___ climb the hill behind the house.
column4: 过去反复的动作,用 would。

# title: I ___ getting up early; it is part of my routine now.
column4: be used to doing 表"已习惯于",此处接 getting。
